---
name: Extension request
about: Propose a new stack extension or a substantive change to an existing one
title: "[Extension] "
labels: extension
assignees: ''

---

## Stack

Which stack is this about? Use the folder name (dotnet, react, python, nodejs, rails, go, java-spring, php-laravel, flutter, swift-ios).

## Type of request

- [ ] I want to claim an open stack and contribute the full extension
- [ ] I want to propose a meaningful change to an existing extension
- [ ] I want to propose a new stack not currently in the list

## What you're proposing

Describe what you want to add, change, or build.

## Real-world grounding

What production work is this based on? You don't have to name clients or share proprietary details — describe the kind of project, the scale, and how long you've worked in this stack.

## If you're claiming an open stack

- [ ] I have read the root CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] I understand that becoming the maintainer is a commitment, not just a credit line
- [ ] I have shipped at least one real production project in this stack
- [ ] I have read the dotnet folder and understand the bar I'm matching

## If you're changing an existing extension

- [ ] I have looked at the current state of the folder and understand what's already there
- [ ] I have considered whether this is a small enough change to PR directly without an issue
- [ ] I am pinging the current maintainer (if any) for input

## If you're proposing a new stack

- [ ] I understand that adding a stack means committing to write all four files
- [ ] I can articulate why FSE in this stack is meaningfully different from the existing ten
- [ ] I am the proposed maintainer

## Anything else

Links, sketches, or partial drafts are welcome.
